title: Design System: Le-Shi System Field Guide

display.purpose: Hero, manifesto, and document masthead statements.

label.purpose: Status, provenance, navigation, and compact controls.

shadows.name: drawer-separation

motion.purpose: Default easing for directional hover and entrance movement.

motion.purpose: Introduces the outer system diagram once on page load.

components.name: Primary Linux Action
components.description: The main forward action for entering the Linux field guide.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { min-height: 54px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 34px; padding: 0 22px; background: var(--linux, #b7f34a); color: var(--accent-ink, #10150f); font-family: Archivo, "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s; } .ds-primary-action span { font-size: 20px; transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-primary-action:hover span { transform: translate(4px, -4px); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--windows, #46c7ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-primary-action:active { filter: brightness(.92); }

components.name: Utility Icon Button
components.description: A square utility control used for search, theme, and repository actions.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" type="button" aria-label="Search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6.5"/><path d="m16 16 4 4"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { width: 38px; height: 38px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--line, #313b35); background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #f1f4ea); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .2s, background .2s; } .ds-icon-button svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-icon-button:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #f1f4ea); background: var(--surface-2, #19211d); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--windows, #46c7ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-icon-button:active { background: var(--surface, #131916); }

components.name: Document Switcher
components.description: Platform tabs with a full signal-color active field.
components.html: LINUXWINDOWS
components.css: .ds-doc-switcher { height: 72px; display: flex; align-items: stretch; border: 1px solid var(--line, #313b35); } .ds-doc-switcher a { min-width: 112px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--muted, #9ca79f); font: 600 10px "Azeret Mono", monospace; text-decoration: none; border-right: 1px solid var(--line, #313b35); } .ds-doc-switcher a:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-doc-switcher a:hover { color: var(--ink, #f1f4ea); background: var(--surface-2, #19211d); } .ds-doc-switcher a.ds-active { color: var(--accent-ink, #10150f); background: var(--linux, #b7f34a); } .ds-doc-switcher a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--windows, #46c7ff); outline-offset: -4px; }

components.name: Platform Entry
components.description: A full-width document entry that reads as a console row instead of a floating card.
components.html: ALinux Mint Field NotesSoftware, terminals, fonts, input methods, and development.
components.css: .ds-platform-entry { min-height: 164px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 50px 1fr 40px; align-items: center; gap: 22px; padding: 28px 4vw; border: 1px solid var(--line, #313b35); color: var(--linux, #b7f34a); text-decoration: none; transition: background .25s; } .ds-entry-number { color: var(--muted, #9ca79f); font: 600 12px "Azeret Mono", monospace; } .ds-entry-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; } .ds-entry-main strong { font: 700 24px Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-entry-main small { color: var(--muted, #9ca79f); line-height: 1.5; } .ds-platform-entry svg { width: 30px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-platform-entry:hover { background: var(--surface, #131916); } .ds-platform-entry:hover svg { transform: translateX(7px); } .ds-platform-entry:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--windows, #46c7ff); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Table of Contents Item
components.description: A quiet reading-navigation row with a platform seam for active state.
components.html: Software installationTerminal configuration
components.css: .ds-toc { width: 260px; padding: 18px 0; background: var(--surface, #131916); border: 1px solid var(--line, #313b35); } .ds-toc a { display: block; padding: 8px 25px; color: var(--muted, #9ca79f); font: 400 12px/1.45 Archivo, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; border-left: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-toc a:hover, .ds-toc a.ds-active { color: var(--ink, #f1f4ea); border-left-color: var(--linux, #b7f34a); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--linux, #b7f34a) 7%, transparent); } .ds-toc a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--windows, #46c7ff); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A borderless field housed inside a sharply seamed search header.
components.css: .ds-search-field { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 15px; padding: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #313b35); background: var(--surface, #131916); color: var(--ink, #f1f4ea); } .ds-search-field svg { width: 20px; fill: none; stroke: var(--muted, #9ca79f); } .ds-search-field input { min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 400 18px Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-search-field button { border: 1px solid var(--line, #313b35); background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #9ca79f); font: 600 8px "Azeret Mono", monospace; padding: 7px; } .ds-search-field:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--windows, #46c7ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-search-field button:hover { color: var(--ink, #f1f4ea); border-color: currentColor; }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: A source-oriented code plane with language provenance and a copy control.
components.html:
sudo apt update

components.css: .ds-code-block { position: relative; padding: 48px 22px 22px; overflow: auto; background: #090c0a; border: 1px solid var(--line, #313b35); color: #d9e4dc; font: 400 14px/1.65 "Azeret Mono", monospace; } .ds-code-block::before { content: attr(data-language); position: absolute; left: 20px; top: 14px; color: #78847c; font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-code-block pre { margin: 0; white-space: pre-wrap; } .ds-code-block button { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; border: 1px solid #354039; background: #141a16; color: #b7c1ba; padding: 7px 10px; font: 600 8px "Azeret Mono", monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-code-block button:hover { color: var(--linux, #b7f34a); border-color: currentColor; } .ds-code-block button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--windows, #46c7ff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-code-block button:active { background: #1b241e; }

narrative.overview:
The site treats a long-lived personal knowledge base as a live control surface rather than a generic blog. Dark console planes, crisp seams, oversized editorial headings, orbit geometry, and compact telemetry labels make Linux and Windows guidance feel like two coordinated systems inside one maintained field guide.

The system is dense but not cramped: large moments establish hierarchy, while the documentation view becomes quiet, linear, and source-focused. Light mode rebinds the same semantic roles without changing the visual grammar. Motion is sparse and purposeful, with a reduced-motion fallback built into the system.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first console surfaces with a complete light-theme remap.
Linux green and Windows blue act as platform signals, not decoration.
Sharp seams, square controls, circular system diagrams, and almost no ornamental radius.
Archivo carries editorial hierarchy; Azeret Mono carries metadata and operational state.
Responsive layouts preserve direct platform access and long-form reading on narrow screens.

rules.name: The Two Signal Rule
rules.body: Linux green means Linux or primary system readiness; Windows blue means Windows or keyboard focus. Do not reuse either as an arbitrary decorative accent.

rules.name: The Theme Rebinding Rule
rules.body: Light mode changes the values of the semantic CSS custom properties, never the meaning or hierarchy of their roles.

rules.name: The Mono Is Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Use the monospaced face for system metadata and controls, not for ordinary paragraphs or expressive headings.

rules.name: The Seam Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use tonal layers and one-pixel borders at rest; reserve shadows for overlays, drawers, and live status.

rules.name: The Square Interface Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce rounded cards or pill controls; circular geometry must communicate system motion, status, or orbit structure.

dos: Do preserve semantic platform color: Linux green for Linux and primary readiness, Windows blue for Windows and focus.
Do use one-pixel seams and tonal layering to organize dense screens.
Do keep long-form content centered, generously led, and visually quieter than the homepage.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, and the mobile bottom document switcher.
Do use monospaced uppercase labels for provenance, status, and compact controls.
donts: Don't turn the site into a generic blog grid of rounded cards.
Don't add gradients, glows, or shadows as decoration; the existing radial field and state shadows are sufficient.
Don't use platform colors interchangeably or flood large unrelated surfaces with them.
Don't set paragraphs, long labels, or Chinese reading copy in the monospaced face.
Don't add motion that competes with reading or ignores the reduced-motion override.
